label: PF Backlog 441
title: WorkerGrid Stage 2: coordinator service + shared coordination store + git sync (fetch/push) for multi-machine (Python spike; Go target)
body:
Extract coordination (registry/leases/dispatch) into a standalone service with a shared store; workers connect via host:port+token; add git sync (fetch before worktree, push after merge, auto-push-after-merge gated). Remove the in-PF worker layer after cut-over. See WORKERGRID-DESIGN.md.

PROGRESS (dedup: 2b-a/2b-b both live inside this umbrella item):
- Stage 2a (done, BI-PF-0411): git sync - core/vcs.py fetch/base_ref/sync + PF_AUTO_PUSH + /pf sync.
- Stage 2b-a (coordinator service + shared store): workergrid/store.py (SQLite shared workers/leases, single-writer) + workergrid/service.py (stdlib HTTP: register/heartbeat, work claim+lease renew/release/recover, /status, bearer token) + `wg serve` verb + service-vs-local mode in wg.py/client.py (config service_host/port, 127.0.0.1:8790, --local fallback). Python spike per design; Go binary + Postgres remain future.
- Stage 2b-b (remove in-PF worker layer): core/dispatcher.py, core/work_pull.py, core/worker_adapters.py, core/worker_registry.py DELETED; engineering router worker/work/dispatch endpoints removed; openapi regenerated; precheck worker gates dropped; single_path_check now FAILS if worker-layer modules exist in core/; 6 obsolete tests removed; test_api_engineering keeps schedule read-only test. Coordination now served by WorkerGrid; PF keeps producer API (schedule/eligibility read + status write-back).
- Cut-over wiring (RCCA on the work_pull deletion): the pickup seams work_pull owned moved to scheduler.next_eligible - grooming.refresh_stale before serving the next item (BI-PF-0389) and pidl.pre_dispatch attach of pidl_context/execution_policy (BI-PF-0379, read-only); workergrid/service.py passes both through to the worker in the /work response. Gates pidl-synthesis + staleness re-pointed at the new seams; wg_surface_check requires the serve verb; /wg command surfaces (project + command_global + installed) list serve.

dashboard_impact.reason: worker coordination moved to external WorkerGrid; PF API/dashboard surfaces shrink only

delivery.note: Stage 2b-a/2b-b merged --no-ff; precheck --full green (824 passed, 1 skipped)

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/artifact_store.py, core/asset_store.py, core/forge_store.py, core/github.py
